question: Find the mode of the given data 22, 16, 17, 49, 7, 16, 45, 17, 7, 6, 16, 17, 22, 7, 16, and 44.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a given set of data.

Scanning the numbers: 16 appears 4 times, 17 appears 3 times, and 7 appears 3 times.

Since 16 has the highest frequency of occurrence, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 22, 16, 17, 49, 7, 16, 45, 17, 7, 6, 16, 17, 22, 7, 16, and 44

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation with the maximum frequency.
